signals.thesis: Lam Research surged +12.7% to a new 52-week high ($364.80) on massive volume (14.5M vs 3.0M avg) as the entire semiconductor equipment complex ripped higher. KLAC led with +12.9%. AMAT +11.2%. The sector is pricing in sustained AI capex demand and a potential CHIPS Act spending acceleration. LRCX's etch and deposition tools are critical for advanced node manufacturing. RSI 67.7 provides room to run before overextension. EMA20 ($316) well below price = momentum confirmed. Entry on pullback to $350 zone gives a clean 2:1 R/R with stop below the breakout level.

positions.thesis: Healthcare sector leader surging +5.2% with massive bullish call flow (20,921 contracts at $400 strike, 5.4x average). Healthcare Plans industry +5% today — best-performing sub-sector. EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200 momentum structure intact. RSI 66.9 — strong without overextension. VIX 15.74 supports risk-on healthcare positioning.
